$comment: `source` is a local path or a clone URL. `uml` is a StarUML .mdj model for
that project -- either an existing one, or one you reverse-engineer from an
early commit and then hold fixed for the whole replay. Holding it fixed is
what makes drift between design and code observable; if the diagram moves
with the code there is nothing to measure.
The bundled entry is the seeded-deviation project, which needs no network.
Add real projects below it. Choose ones where a class diagram is meaningful:
layered applications with named services and repositories, not scripts.
Aim for 5-10 projects x 30-50 commits each.

projects.name: reference-orders
projects.notes: The bundled reference project. Used by evaluate_deviations.py; a single commit, so replay over it is trivial.
